# kgmaker repository context

This repository uses kgmaker with GitHub Copilot CLI. `.kgmaker/GRAPH.md` is a local structural map of the repository; `.kgmaker/NOTES.md` contains verified semantic notes. Use both to navigate, then verify every conclusion in source. Run `kgmaker scan` after structural changes. Do not treat heuristic call edges as confirmed behavior. For agent-authored semantic relationships, use the `kgmaker-extract` custom agent; validate `.kgmaker/semantic.json` with `kgmaker semantic validate` before rescanning. The graph is generated locally and must not contain secrets, credentials, or external links.
